meta.evidence_status: simulation (hand-pen-paper model H1, synthetic handwriting and tremor; nothing measured)

frames.page: x right, y up the page, z out of the page (stabpen/frames.py)
frames.pen: a = axis nib->cap, altitude 50 deg, azimuth 0 (a = cos50 x + sin50 z); t1 = sin50 x - cos50 z (tilt plane); t2 = y
frames.tilt_rad: (beta1, beta2): a point z along the axis moves z (beta1 t1 + beta2 t2)
frames.nib: ball contact point (ball centre minus r_b in z), m, page frame
frames.grip: pen point at the finger-pad zone (z_f), m, page frame
frames.ink: page projection of the ball centre plus the stage correction, m
frames.ref_nib, ref_ink: the same pen and device on the same handwriting without tremor (the ratio reference), same times
frames.device.r_pen_frame_m: reaction-mass displacement relative to the pen along t1, t2, a
frames.device.gimbal_rad: CMG pair gimbal angles (pair 1 torques about t2, pair 2 about t1)
frames.device.stage_q_m: nib-stage deflection at the nib along t1, t2 (ink moves q1/sin(theta) along x, q2 along y)

evidence.grip: LIT HAP-26 (calibration) + ASSUMPTION split r_rot 0.5, rho_w 0.3

cases.unmodified: Pencil with the stage held at centre and no helper: the ink carries the hand tremor minus what the skid friction absorbs.
cases.reaction_mass: 5.15 g tungsten slug in the cap moved +/-1.0 mm sideways and +/-2 mm axially by voice coils, driven with perfect knowledge of the tremor (iterative-learning oracle). Best inertial helper within the 20 g target.
cases.stage: Piezo nib stage alone with perfect knowledge of the tremor (model P1 oracle, +/-0.30 mm usable, 0.40 mm stop).
cases.stage+reaction_mass: Nib stage plus the reaction mass, both with perfect knowledge.
cases.cmg: Two scissored pairs of control-moment gyroscopes (4 tungsten rotors at 60 000 rpm, gimbals +/-0.6 rad, 30 rad/s). Over the mass budget (about 25 g) and needs about 0.5 W; shown because gyroscopes were asked about.
cases.stage+cmg: Nib stage plus the two CMG pairs.

meta.case_group: Weights and gyroscopes in the cap: 8 Hz, 0.3 mm tremor (hand-pen model H1, perfect knowledge)

cases.label: Unmodified pencil
cases.note: No correction. The pen tilts in the grip and slides on its skid; the ink carries the hand's tremor minus what the skid friction absorbs. The rings show where the fingers and the thumb-index web hold the pen.

cases.label: Reaction mass in the cap (oracle)
cases.note: A 5.15 g tungsten slug in the cap, pushed sideways and along the pen by coils, with perfect knowledge of the tremor. It is the best moving weight that fits the 20 g target, and it takes half the cell.

cases.label: Nib stage (oracle)
cases.note: The piezo nib stage alone, with perfect knowledge of the tremor. The same result as the pencil group, in the model that lets the pen tilt in the grip.

cases.label: Nib stage + reaction mass (oracle)
cases.note: Nib stage plus the tungsten slug: the slug shaves the tremor peaks the stage cannot reach.

cases.label: CMG pairs in the cap (oracle, over budget)
cases.note: Two pairs of spinning tungsten rotors (60 000 rpm, spin slowed for display) on motorised gimbals that tip them to make torque. The strongest inertial option studied, but about 25 g and 0.34 W, with no room left for the cell; the full unit needs about 20 mm more length than the pen has.

cases.label: Nib stage + CMG (oracle)
cases.note: Nib stage plus the gyroscope pairs: the best physics studied, and impossible packaging.
